continuation: Held full-replay event under existing supervisor/notifier. Verify all plans, sources, scores, generated records, scalar posteriors, policy choices and costs before acceptance. Then assess remaining useful registered extensions against actual remaining exploration budget; fixed confirmation and report clocks remain unchanged.
controls: Confident base error with a surprise trigger.
Correct base and no surprise trigger.
Uninformative records return unchanged prior across outcomes.
Duplicate successor changes no posterior mass.
Independent scalar enumeration matches every policy on all four-record binary patterns.
Every complete consumer probability and decision independently checked.
costs: Expected-gain planning evaluates all four model likelihoods and every candidate subset even when k=1. Record these counts and all charged CPU. The .01 per-addition utility fee is hypothetical and distinct from CPU; no cheap-search claim. Fixed search pays for a redundant fourth candidate even though its prior mass is deduplicated.
criteria: Descriptive held-out uncapped log loss, full Brier, modal accuracy, confident errors, realized loss plus declared fee, omitted/absent expansion fractions, likelihood and subset costs. Continue only if predictive benefit and unnecessary expansion jointly warrant further testing; no B/C superiority screen or promotion.
evidence: Historical context/observed-output pairs and query context, with supplied response library, reliability and cue noise. Evaluator-only fields contain true model, query truth and random draws.
generator: Per-world reliability Uniform(.82,.94). Omission absent uses base; omission present samples the three distinct successors uniformly. Contexts have four equiprobable states. Sixteen historical observations independently combine mechanism noise and cue noise; current query has mechanism noise only. Shared uniforms pair conditions; query draws are independent of historical records. No query target enters decisions.
library: Base output is first context bit. Registered successors XOR it with the second context bit, the both-bits-set indicator, or unequal-context-bits indicator. These stipulate belief, constraint and operation-order switches; their psychological semantics are not measured. Fourth successor aliases the base and contributes no extra prior mass.
limitations: Entire library, prior and channel supplied; no open-world invention or fitted mechanism detection.
Expected-gain is a privileged full-library planner, not a proof of bounded cheap search.
Known confidence failure is built into the ruler.
No execution-shift or feature-product arm; redundant-law removal is a separate control.
pairing: Eight worlds, no fitted parameters/seeds. All cases, conditions, budgets and policies nest inside a world. 4096 paired whole-world resamples; no case-level confidence intervals.
population: Eight separately drawn reliability worlds with paired absent/present omission, weak/strong records and held-out independent queries. Reused development identities, no confirmation.
prior: Base mass .5 and each of three distinct successor laws mass 1/6. Posterior over selected unique laws renormalizes their original masses. Alias never duplicates prior mass.
question: Can predictive evidence trigger useful finite model expansion when the initial model is confidently wrong, without chronic unnecessary expansion?

readers.confidence: Expand the fixed ordered prefix only if base maximum target probability is below .75; the known-answer initial model remains confident.
readers.expected_gain: Compute the full-library posterior; enumerate all subsets of at most k additions, minimize expected query log loss over four contexts plus .01 per added hypothesis. Break ties within 1e-12 by fewer additions then lexicographic order.
readers.fixed: Always consider first k registered successors.
readers.full_library: Diagnostic posterior over all four distinct laws.
readers.surprise: Expand ordered prefix only if exact lower binomial tail of base historical matches is at most .05.

validation: Three focused controls, complete duplicate engineering consumers at 8 and registered 16 records, full-size 16-record pilot, and required full scientific replay. The 8-record fixture remains engineering-only; no scientific identity was executed under it.
